name: Executable sell-depth recovery
hypothesis: Buy a confirmed higher low after full-position sell quotes recover and independent inflow resumes.
spec: Setup: Restored exit capacity can make a previously blocked long thesis tradeable. Entry: Buy a confirmed higher low after full-position sell quotes recover and independent inflow resumes. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on depth loss or lower-low invalidation. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs executable DEX pool depth and quote history (not connected)
